facts.business: SMR Jewels Limited designs and sells designer heritage, nature-inspired, traditional (Jadtar, Meenakari, Polki, bridal), and daily wear jewellery, outsourcing manufacturing to job workers while maintaining in-house design and customization services.
key_risks: Revenue recognition timing and estimation adjustments
Dependence on outsourced job workers for manufacturing
Extended credit periods leading to slower collections
Higher credit purchases increasing trade payables
